howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Download the resized video
howto.text: FFmpeg scales the video to the target height while preserving aspect ratio.

faq.a: No — upscaling can't add detail. Use it to match a target resolution, not to improve quality.
Audio is copied unchanged when possible (saves time, no quality loss).

faq.q: Can I crop to a different aspect ratio?
faq.a: Not directly — the resizer preserves aspect ratio. For aspect-ratio crops, use a video editor.
